tools.name: wisepops_list_popups
tools.description: List your WisePops pop-ups with their ID, label, activation state, creation date, and display, click and email counts. Use an ID as wisepop_id in wisepops_list_contacts. WisePops API: GET /api2/wisepops.

tools.name: wisepops_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (emails and other form fields) that your pop-ups collected, with the collection time, pop-up ID, IP and country. Filter by collected_after (UTC) and wisepop_id. Needs a WisePops Custom plan; standard usage is 1,500 API calls per 30 days. WisePops API: GET /api2/contacts.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wisepops_list_popups, wisepops_list_contacts · Private data: wisepops_list_contacts · Public sink: wisepops_list_popups.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wisepops_list_popups, wisepops_list_contacts · Private data: wisepops_list_contacts · Public sink: wisepops_list_popups

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
